title: Committed kb reads retry a timed-out git call once
summary: Committed reads in `@inventarch/kb`, which `kb pack` and the legacy committed writer use, now give a git call that timed out, such as one a stalled process held past its 10-second bound, one more try under the same bound before refusing with `IA-KB-SOURCE-UNAVAILABLE`. Any other git failure still refuses at once. The 10-second default and the 30-second cap on `gitTimeoutMs` stay as they are. A git call that times out on both tries refuses after its second try, about 20 seconds at the default.
